items.claim: A UNION-based SQL injection is confirmed by matching the result-set column count through successively longer runs of NULL placeholders, and NULL is used as the filler because it type-checks in any column position and so maximises the chance the payload succeeds.
items.body:
A UNION-based SQL injection is confirmed by matching the result-set column count through successively longer runs of NULL placeholders, and NULL is used as the filler because it type-checks in any column position and so maximises the chance the payload succeeds.

HackTricks reference: sql injection (https://kathan19.gitbook.io/howtohunt/sqli/sql_injection.md)
items.disproof: If no NULL-counted payload ever produces the extra result set or alters the response, the column count was never matched and the UNION injection is not demonstrated.

sources.quote:
' UNION SELECT NULL --
 ' UNION SELECT NULL, NULL --
 ' UNION SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL --

 (Using NULL maximizes the probability that the payload will succeed.
For example, consider using persistence layers such as Hibernate or Enterprise Java Beans, which can provide significant protection against SQL injection if used properly.

You should be very careful whenever you write raw SQL. Every time you use it, you should properly escape any parameters that the user can control by using params in order to protect against SQL injection attacks.
